sources.title: Supertonic 3 — Lightning-Fast, On-Device, Multilingual TTS
sources.snippet: 99M-parameter open-weight TTS running locally on CPU. 31 languages. No GPU, no cloud, no API.

sources.title: Supertone/supertonic-3 · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: What's New in Supertonic 3 31 languages: expanded from the 5-language Supertonic 2 release. More stable reading: fewer repeat and skip failures, especially on short and long utterances. Higher speaker similarity: improved similarity across the shared-language set compared with Supertonic 2.
